<b>{{PAGENAME}}s</b> are a common crafting material, used to make tools or processed into building materials. They can be crafted using [[iron ore]] in the [[furnace]], or alternatively may be purchased from the [[Blacksmith]]. As the first significant in-game challenge is getting a supply of iron up and running, one may need to rely on the Blacksmith, as it's otherwise difficult to advance.
